_readme: What a store listing may promise, per claim, and the capability each promise needs. Read by ONE guard: tooling/ci/assert-store-metadata.mjs, its LISTING CLAIMS limb (ST-U4). Reminder claims are NOT here: they are graded against tooling/capability-register.json's notifications platformMatrix (canSchedule) by the same guard's REMINDER CLAIMS limb, because that table is held to the Dart by assert-adapter-capabilities.mjs limb 8. A pattern is matched per line, case-insensitively, against every *.txt of every store tree of every app and of the brick. An app or platform with no boolean answer here is COVERAGE LOST, never a pass.

trial.rule: a listing may promise anything about a free trial only for an app whose data model records one
trial._why: subscriptiontracker: the Subscription model (apps/subscriptiontracker/lib/data/models/subscription.dart) has no trial field, so no reminder, total or list can be about a trial. ST-T3 (ADR 077 §5, owner-approved 2026-09-11) adds trials; flip this to true in the change that ships them, and the copy may return. brick: a stamped app starts with no domain model at all.

offline-on-device.rule: a listing may promise that the list works offline and stays on the device only on a channel whose every platform keeps it there
offline-on-device._why: Native builds read the list through CachedApiClient over LocalSubscriptionStore (apps/subscriptiontracker/lib/data/api/cached_api_client.dart, data/local/subscription_store.dart), persisted by the keyValueStoreProvider seam (packages/platform_storage) on every native platform. web is false: it has no store listing today, and a browser's storage can be cleared by the browser — a promise this app cannot keep there.
